How to cut last-mile delivery costs

Five practical changes that save real money.

LLim Wei Jian12 March 2026

Good writing starts with a clear question. In this article we explore the idea in plain language, with examples you can use straight away.

The first thing to understand is that small decisions compound. Choosing carefully at the start saves far more time than it costs, and it makes every later step easier.

We have tested these approaches with real clients over several years. Some worked immediately; others needed adjusting. Here is what we learned.

Three things to remember

  • Start with the outcome you want.
  • Test small before you commit.
  • Write down what you learn.

pages.html:
Home/FAQ
Help

FAQ

Answers to the questions we hear most.

How do I track a parcel?

Enter your tracking number on the Track page or in our app.

Do you offer cash on delivery?

Yes, with remittance within two working days.

What is the weight limit?

Couriers carry up to 30 kg. Freight handles pallets and full loads.

Can I integrate with my shop?

Plug-ins for Shopee, Lazada, Shopify and WooCommerce plus an open API.

What if a parcel is damaged?

Every parcel is insured up to RM 500. Higher cover is available.

Do you deliver to Sabah and Sarawak?

Yes, by air and sea with delivery in 3–5 days.

Still have questions?

Our team is happy to help.
